items.title: Practice Bind and Reverse Bond
items.description: Use Tri's lessons to distinguish moving an object from letting its movement carry Zelda.

description_i18n.en: Use Tri's lessons to distinguish moving an object from letting its movement carry Zelda.

items.details: Bind makes the selected object follow Zelda's movement; Reverse Bond makes Zelda follow the object's movement instead. Lock onto the intended target before binding, then use the prompted reverse command when you want a platform or climbing creature to carry you. Release the connection before it takes you into danger. Binding also pulls buried chests and removes certain shields or rooted enemies. In the first sword-opponent fight, pulling away the shield creates an opening for your combat echoes; you do not need to win by throwing furniture forever.

details_i18n.en: Bind makes the selected object follow Zelda's movement; Reverse Bond makes Zelda follow the object's movement instead. Lock onto the intended target before binding, then use the prompted reverse command when you want a platform or climbing creature to carry you. Release the connection before it takes you into danger. Binding also pulls buried chests and removes certain shields or rooted enemies. In the first sword-opponent fight, pulling away the shield creates an opening for your combat echoes; you do not need to win by throwing furniture forever.
details_i18n.pt: Bind faz o objeto selecionado acompanhar Zelda; Reverse Bond faz Zelda acompanhar o movimento do objeto. Mire no alvo correto antes de conectar e use o comando indicado de inversão quando quiser ser carregado por uma plataforma ou criatura que escala. Solte a conexão antes de entrar em perigo. Bind também puxa baús enterrados e remove certos escudos ou inimigos enraizados. Na primeira luta com o adversário de espada, puxar o escudo abre espaço para os ecos de combate; não é necessário vencer apenas arremessando móveis.

items.details: Swordfighter Form drains its own energy while active, so switch back when an opening ends rather than leaving it running during travel. Blue energy pickups restore the gauge, especially in rifts; certain smoothies also restore energy, so read their effects before mixing. Echoes can fight while you conserve the meter. Spend Might Crystals at Lueburry's house for weapon and gauge upgrades as they unlock. The bow and bombs become available through later dungeons, not simply by buying an upgrade early.

details_i18n.en: Swordfighter Form drains its own energy while active, so switch back when an opening ends rather than leaving it running during travel. Blue energy pickups restore the gauge, especially in rifts; certain smoothies also restore energy, so read their effects before mixing. Echoes can fight while you conserve the meter. Spend Might Crystals at Lueburry's house for weapon and gauge upgrades as they unlock. The bow and bombs become available through later dungeons, not simply by buying an upgrade early.
details_i18n.pt: Swordfighter Form consome sua própria energia enquanto está ativa; volte à forma normal quando a abertura terminar em vez de mantê-la durante o deslocamento. Itens azuis recuperam a barra, especialmente nas fendas; certos smoothies também restauram energia, então confira os efeitos antes de prepará-los. Os ecos podem lutar enquanto você economiza a barra. Gaste Might Crystals na casa de Lueburry para melhorar armas e energia conforme os desbloqueios. O arco e as bombas vêm de masmorras posteriores, não apenas da compra antecipada de uma melhoria.

items.details: Watch the glowing orb rather than attacking the stone body at random. After a hand slam leaves an opening, Bind the orb and pull until it comes free, or strike the exposed target with Swordfighter attacks. Damage the separated core before it returns to the body. Its position changes between phases, so adjust your angle and use the lowered hand as a route when needed. Move out of the spinning-arm attack and collect dropped energy before the next opening if your gauge is low.

details_i18n.en: Watch the glowing orb rather than attacking the stone body at random. After a hand slam leaves an opening, Bind the orb and pull until it comes free, or strike the exposed target with Swordfighter attacks. Damage the separated core before it returns to the body. Its position changes between phases, so adjust your angle and use the lowered hand as a route when needed. Move out of the spinning-arm attack and collect dropped energy before the next opening if your gauge is low.
details_i18n.pt: Observe a esfera luminosa em vez de atacar o corpo de pedra sem critério. Depois que uma pancada da mão abrir espaço, use Bind na esfera e puxe até soltá-la, ou golpeie o alvo exposto com Swordfighter. Cause dano ao núcleo separado antes que volte ao corpo. A posição muda entre fases; ajuste o ângulo e use a mão abaixada como caminho quando necessário. Saia do ataque de braços giratórios e recolha energia antes da próxima abertura se sua barra estiver baixa.

items.details: The two required tributes are the Elephant Statue and Hawk Statue echoes. Learn the actual statues in their dungeon rooms; having seen their shapes in a mural does not add them to your echo list. Return to the tribute door and summon one of each on the two pads. Other statue species do not satisfy the inscription. Keep these echoes available afterward: the sturdy statues also provide useful obstacles in the boss arena. If a pedestal looks empty, check your active echo budget before assuming the placement failed.

details_i18n.en: The two required tributes are the Elephant Statue and Hawk Statue echoes. Learn the actual statues in their dungeon rooms; having seen their shapes in a mural does not add them to your echo list. Return to the tribute door and summon one of each on the two pads. Other statue species do not satisfy the inscription. Keep these echoes available afterward: the sturdy statues also provide useful obstacles in the boss arena. If a pedestal looks empty, check your active echo budget before assuming the placement failed.
details_i18n.pt: Os dois tributos exigidos são os ecos Elephant Statue e Hawk Statue. Aprenda as estátuas nas salas correspondentes; apenas ver as formas em um mural não as adiciona à lista de ecos. Volte à porta e invoque uma de cada nos dois suportes. Outros tipos de estátua não cumprem a inscrição. Mantenha esses ecos disponíveis depois: as estátuas resistentes também ajudam como obstáculos na arena do chefe. Se um suporte parecer vazio, confira o limite de ecos ativos antes de presumir que a posição falhou.

items.details: The Stilled Upper Zora River repair needs five trapped friend groups. Search both sides of the entrance and inspect underwater pockets as well as the upper floating sections. Learn Bombfish when you encounter one: its explosion clears cracked underwater blocks hiding a route. Summon it near the obstruction and keep Zelda out of the blast area. Defeat dark enemies when they hold a friend cluster, then touch the released cluster. Check the counter before leaving a section so a submerged group does not force a complete second search.

Defeat dark enemies when they hold a friend cluster, then touch the released cluster. Check the counter before leaving a section so a submerged group does not force a complete second search.
details_i18n.pt: O reparo de Stilled Upper Zora River exige cinco grupos de amigos presos. Examine os dois lados da entrada, os bolsões submersos e as partes flutuantes superiores. Aprenda Bombfish ao encontrá-lo: sua explosão libera blocos subaquáticos rachados que escondem uma passagem. Invoque-o perto do obstáculo e tire Zelda da área da explosão. Derrote inimigos escuros que guardem um grupo e toque no grupo liberado. Confira o contador antes de sair para não precisar refazer toda a busca por um grupo submerso.

items.details: The central jet rises as you activate the colored switches in the surrounding branches. Treat each branch as a separate loop: explore it, activate its switch and return to the central chamber to inspect the changed access. Underwater, move obstructing rocks with Bind and preserve breathing room. Strong currents can destroy poorly placed Water Blocks, so use existing ledges or a bridge above the flow when possible. Before revisiting a finished branch, compare the central mechanism with the switches you have already activated.

details_i18n.en: The central jet rises as you activate the colored switches in the surrounding branches. Treat each branch as a separate loop: explore it, activate its switch and return to the central chamber to inspect the changed access. Underwater, move obstructing rocks with Bind and preserve breathing room. Strong currents can destroy poorly placed Water Blocks, so use existing ledges or a bridge above the flow when possible. Before revisiting a finished branch, compare the central mechanism with the switches you have already activated.
details_i18n.pt: O jato central sobe conforme você ativa os interruptores coloridos nas alas ao redor. Trate cada ala como um circuito: explore, ative o interruptor e volte à câmara central para conferir os acessos alterados. Sob a água, mova as pedras com Bind e preserve espaço para respirar. Correntes fortes podem destruir Water Blocks mal posicionados; use apoios existentes ou uma ponte acima da corrente quando possível. Antes de revisitar uma ala concluída, compare o mecanismo central aos interruptores já ativados.

items.details: Avoid the whirlpool attack and use its recovery window to reach the blue bulbs on Vocavor's back. Aquatic combat echoes such as Chompfin can attack those targets while submerged; after the bulbs break, damage the exposed weak point. In the later phase, parts of the surrounding water disappear, so a purely aquatic summon may no longer reach its target. Reposition and use an airborne attacker when the back is out of water. Save Swordfighter energy for an opening you can actually reach instead of draining it during pursuit.

details_i18n.en: Avoid the whirlpool attack and use its recovery window to reach the blue bulbs on Vocavor's back. Aquatic combat echoes such as Chompfin can attack those targets while submerged; after the bulbs break, damage the exposed weak point. In the later phase, parts of the surrounding water disappear, so a purely aquatic summon may no longer reach its target. Reposition and use an airborne attacker when the back is out of water. Save Swordfighter energy for an opening you can actually reach instead of draining it during pursuit.
details_i18n.pt: Evite o redemoinho e aproveite a recuperação para alcançar os bulbos azuis nas costas de Vocavor. Ecos aquáticos como Chompfin atingem esses alvos submersos; depois que os bulbos quebrarem, ataque o ponto fraco exposto. Na fase posterior, partes da água ao redor desaparecem, então uma invocação apenas aquática pode não alcançar o alvo. Reposicione-se e use um atacante aéreo quando as costas estiverem fora da água. Reserve a energia de Swordfighter para uma abertura alcançável em vez de gastá-la na perseguição.

items.details: Keep moving out of the trident thrust's line and attack after Ganon commits to a strike or waits for his thrown weapon to return. When he launches the glowing energy ball, a timed Swordfighter sword swing can send it back; be ready for another return rather than immediately running forward. items.details: Dodge the fireballs and large green projectile instead of trying to volley them like Ganon's energy ball. When the head is reachable, target the green necklace orb with Bind and pull backward until it breaks away. This stuns Volvagia and gives your echoes or Swordfighter attacks a clear damage window. Reposition when the dragon changes lava holes; a slow ground echo may not reach the next position. Preserve a safe landing spot and do not chase a disappearing head across exposed lava.

details_i18n.en: Dodge the fireballs and large green projectile instead of trying to volley them like Ganon's energy ball. When the head is reachable, target the green necklace orb with Bind and pull backward until it breaks away. This stuns Volvagia and gives your echoes or Swordfighter attacks a clear damage window. details_i18n.pt: Evite as bolas de fogo e o grande projétil verde em vez de tentar devolvê-los como a esfera de Ganon. Quando a cabeça estiver alcançável, mire na esfera verde do colar com Bind e puxe para trás até arrancá-la. Isso atordoa Volvagia e abre espaço para ecos ou ataques de Swordfighter. Reposicione-se quando o dragão mudar de buraco na lava; um eco terrestre lento pode não alcançar a próxima posição. Preserve um local seguro e não persiga a cabeça que desaparece pela lava exposta.

items.details: The green crystals need electricity, and several rooms require all of them to remain active together. Inspect around movable rocks and boxes before deciding a crystal is missing. A Spark follows a wall, while Buzz Blobs and Electric Keese give other ways to reach awkward targets. In the room with two crystals above the water, a connecting Water Block and an electrical echo can carry the effect between them. Watch the activation timing and resummon near the next target instead of waiting across the room.

details_i18n.en: The green crystals need electricity, and several rooms require all of them to remain active together. Inspect around movable rocks and boxes before deciding a crystal is missing. details_i18n.pt: Os cristais verdes exigem eletricidade, e várias salas precisam de todos ativos ao mesmo tempo. Examine pedras e caixas móveis antes de concluir que falta um cristal. Na sala com dois cristais sobre a água, um Water Block conectando os pontos e um eco elétrico podem transmitir o efeito entre eles. items.details: Target the green crystals on Gohma's legs and send electrical echoes to activate them. All three activated crystals knock the boss down, exposing the eye to strong echo attacks or Swordfighter damage. Keep moving while the boss is on the wall and clear webs or small enemies when they block your route. Resummon an electric attacker near the intended leg if it keeps attacking something else. Continue watching the crystal state after the boss recovers; ordinary sword swings against guarded legs do not replace the electrical setup.

details_i18n.en: Target the green crystals on Gohma's legs and send electrical echoes to activate them. All three activated crystals knock the boss down, exposing the eye to strong echo attacks or Swordfighter damage. Keep moving while the boss is on the wall and clear webs or small enemies when they block your route. Resummon an electric attacker near the intended leg if it keeps attacking something else. Continue watching the crystal state after the boss recovers; ordinary sword swings against guarded legs do not replace the electrical setup.
details_i18n.pt: Mire nos cristais verdes das pernas de Gohma e envie ecos elétricos para ativá-los. Os três cristais ativos derrubam a chefe e expõem o olho a ecos fortes ou golpes de Swordfighter. Movimente-se enquanto ela estiver na parede e remova teias ou inimigos pequenos que bloqueiem sua rota. Invoque um atacante elétrico perto da perna desejada se ele insistir em outro alvo. Confira os cristais após a recuperação da chefe; golpes comuns nas pernas protegidas não substituem a preparação elétrica.

items.details: The movable orb determines the connected device's element. Fire and cold sources can change that orb before you place it in its socket, so inspect the airflow along the transport route. Use solid echoes to block an unwanted vent and carry the orb with Bind through a safe line. A frozen room can make water walkable and change how switches are reached. For paired pressure switches, both must activate at the same moment: send an Armos toward one and step on the other as it lands, or time a sliding Ice Block.

details_i18n.en: The movable orb determines the connected device's element. Fire and cold sources can change that orb before you place it in its socket, so inspect the airflow along the transport route. Use solid echoes to block an unwanted vent and carry the orb with Bind through a safe line. A frozen room can make water walkable and change how switches are reached. For paired pressure switches, both must activate at the same moment: send an Armos toward one and step on the other as it lands, or time a sliding Ice Block.
details_i18n.pt: A esfera móvel determina o elemento do dispositivo conectado. Fontes de fogo e frio podem alterá-la antes da colocação no encaixe; examine as correntes de ar no percurso. Use ecos sólidos para bloquear uma saída indesejada e carregue a esfera com Bind por uma linha segura. Congelar uma sala permite caminhar sobre a água e muda o acesso aos interruptores. Nos interruptores duplos, os dois precisam ser ativados juntos: envie um Armos a um e pise no outro quando ele chegar, ou sincronize um Ice Block deslizando.

items.details: Choose the opposite element to the helmet: fire echoes break ice horns, while ice echoes break fire horns. Once the armor is removed, use a strong attacker or Swordfighter Form against the body, but remain ready to dodge because vulnerability does not make every movement harmless. In the last phase, read the current horn color instead of repeating the previous summon automatically. Fire Keese and Ice Keese provide alternatives to Wizzrobes, so a missing particular high-cost echo does not permanently block the fight.

items.details: Before this dungeon, Zelda returns the Swordfighter equipment to Link; the final route is built around echoes and Tri rather than restoring that form. During the boss, Bind an extended arm and pull it away from the wall to expose it for Link or a combat echo. Keep moving clear of slams while maintaining support. In the underwater phase, use aquatic attackers against the trailing growths and follow the target through the tunnels. Adapt your summons again when the arena returns, and complete the final shared pulling prompt.

details_i18n.en: Before this dungeon, Zelda returns the Swordfighter equipment to Link; the final route is built around echoes and Tri rather than restoring that form. During the boss, Bind an extended arm and pull it away from the wall to expose it for Link or a combat echo. Keep moving clear of slams while maintaining support. In the underwater phase, use aquatic attackers against the trailing growths and follow the target through the tunnels. Adapt your summons again when the arena returns, and complete the final shared pulling prompt.
details_i18n.pt: Antes desta masmorra, Zelda devolve o equipamento de Swordfighter a Link; a rota final usa ecos e Tri em vez de recuperar essa forma. Contra o chefe, use Bind em um braço estendido e puxe-o da parede para expô-lo a Link ou a um eco de combate. Evite as pancadas enquanto mantém o apoio. Na fase subaquática, use atacantes aquáticos contra as extensões traseiras e siga o alvo pelos túneis. Adapte as invocações novamente quando a arena voltar e conclua o comando final de puxar em conjunto.

items.details: After Still Missing, help Dampé with the crow north of Hyrule Ranch and visit the marked studio. Demonstrate Tektite and Mothula echoes for the first project, then read his notebook for follow-up requests. Later projects need earned physical parts as well as echoes: the Prismatic Music Box comes from the ranch's middle Flag Race, the Steel Trap from western Hyrule Field's Acorn Gathering, and the Golden Fan from Mango Rush. Automatons use their winding key and can need repairs; they are a separate optional tool, not entries that replace learned echoes.

details_i18n.en: After Still Missing, help Dampé with the crow north of Hyrule Ranch and visit the marked studio. Demonstrate Tektite and Mothula echoes for the first project, then read his notebook for follow-up requests. Later projects need earned physical parts as well as echoes: the Prismatic Music Box comes from the ranch's middle Flag Race, the Steel Trap from western Hyrule Field's Acorn Gathering, and the Golden Fan from Mango Rush. Automatons use their winding key and can need repairs; they are a separate optional tool, not entries that replace learned echoes.
details_i18n.pt: Após Still Missing, ajude Dampé com o corvo ao norte de Hyrule Ranch e visite o estúdio marcado. Mostre ecos Tektite e Mothula no primeiro projeto e leia o caderno para receber novos pedidos. Projetos posteriores exigem peças físicas recebidas como prêmio além de ecos: Prismatic Music Box vem da Flag Race intermediária, Steel Trap do Acorn Gathering no oeste de Hyrule Field e Golden Fan de Mango Rush. Autômatos usam uma chave de corda e podem precisar de reparos; são ferramentas opcionais separadas, não substitutos dos ecos aprendidos.
